request.style: English, male soulful voice, solo, acoustic guitar, upright bass, piano, organ, slow blues, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He came to Jesus by night
Asked how a man can be born new
No signs like yours without God
But how can this be done for you

[Chorus]
Unless someone is born of water and the Spirit
He cannot enter the kingdom of God
What is born of the flesh is flesh
And what is born of the Spirit is spirit

[Verse]
I told you truly and again
You must be born from above
Do not be astonished at this word
The wind blows where it wills, no love lost

[Chorus]
Unless someone is born of water and the Spirit
He cannot enter the kingdom of God
What is born of the flesh is flesh
And what is born of the Spirit is spirit

[Bridge]
You hear its sound but not its source
Where it comes from or goes, unknown
So it is with everyone
Born of the Spirit, standing alone

[Chorus]
Unless someone is born of water and the Spirit
He cannot enter the kingdom of God
What is born of the flesh is flesh
And what is born of the Spirit is spirit

[Outro]
How can this be, I ask
Born of water and the Spirit
